def _reused(root: Path, action: str, stage: str, work_item: str, commands: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], repo: Path,
            held: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]) -> Optional[Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]]]:
    """The runs of this action's passed check record, held to today's floors, when ``complete`` takes them instead
    of running every command again (owner decision D5, 2026-10-17); else None.

    It takes them when that record passed at this stage and item, lists exactly ``commands``, and the repository's
    working content (``_tree``) is now a tree the check's run started on or left.  A run the floor now refuses is
    not taken: the commands run again, so a refusal always comes from a run made now.  Returns (runs, the ``reused``
    entry the counted record carries: which check record and the tree).
    """
    path = Path(root) / check_path(action)
    if not path.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        record = store.read_record(path)
    except (OSError, store.StorageError):
        return None
    if not (isinstance(record, Mapping) and record.get("passed") is True
            and record.get("schema") == SCHEMA and record.get("stage") == stage
            and record.get("work_item") == work_item and record.get("commands") == list(commands)
            and record.get("trees")):
        return None
    tree = _tree(root, repo)
    if not tree or tree not in record["trees"]:
        return None
    runs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for run in record.get("runs") or ():
        run = {key: value for key, value in run.items() if key not in ("accepted_ran", "floor_from")}
        floor = held.get(run.get("command"))
        if floor:
            run["accepted_ran"] = floor["floor"]
            run["floor_from"] = floor["from"]
            if run.get("status") == "passed" and run.get("counts") and run["counts"]["ran"] < floor["floor"]:
                return None
        runs.append(run)
    return runs, {"path": check_path(action), "created_at": record.get("created_at"), "tree": tree}

def answer_key(root: Path, state: Mapping[str, Any], action_id: str, stage: str | None, work_item: str | None,
               draft: Path, *, lint_option: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Everything the gates read, as one comparable value; computed after the check's gates ran, since a test run may
    leave an untracked file, and again by ``complete`` before it takes a yes."""
    root = Path(root)
    contract = None
    if stage in loops.STAGES:
        try:
            contract = _sha(loop_contract.dumps(loops.contract(root, state, action_id)).encode("utf-8"))
        except loops.LoopError:
            contract = None
    try:
        draft_sha = _sha(Path(draft).read_bytes())
    except OSError:
        draft_sha = None
    base = lint.read_base(root, work_item) if work_item else None
    return {
        "revision": state.get("revision"),
        "version": reference.package_version(),
        "test_schema": test_loop.SCHEMA,
        "contract": contract,
        "draft": draft_sha,
        "tree": test_loop.working_tree(root, Path(str(state["repo"]))) or None,
        "base": {"tree": (base or {}).get("tree"),
                 "preparatory": expectations.preparatory_commit(root, work_item) if work_item else None},
        "floors": {"action": test_loop.action_counts(root, action_id),
                   "item": test_loop.accepted_counts(root, state, work_item) if work_item else {}},
        "lint": lint_option,
    }
